  @@unique([workspaceId, hash])
  @@map("ai_formula_cache")
}

/// A workspace-scoped API key for the public /api/v1 surface. Only the sha256 of the secret is
/// stored (keyHash), exactly like WorkspaceInvitation.tokenHash: the plaintext is shown once at
/// creation and never again. keyPrefix is a short non-secret label ("dbk_live_a1b2c3d4") so the
/// UI can identify a key without revealing it. Authenticated unscoped by keyHash (lib/api-auth.ts).
model WorkspaceApiKey {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  keyHash     String    @unique @map("key_hash")
  keyPrefix   String    @map("key_prefix")
  name        String
  createdById String?   @map("created_by_id") @db.Uuid
  lastUsedAt  DateTime? @map("last_used_at")
  revokedAt   DateTime? @map("revoked_at")
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdBy   User?     @relation("ApiKeyCreator", fields: [createdById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([workspaceId])
  @@map("workspace_api_keys")
}

/// A registered receiver for workspace lifecycle events. `secretEnc` is the HMAC signing secret,
/// AES-GCM-sealed (lib/secret-crypto.ts) and shown in plaintext only once at creation. `events`
/// empty means "all events". An endpoint is auto-disabled after `failureCount` reaches the cap
/// (see lib/webhook-delivery.ts) so a permanently-broken URL stops consuming delivery attempts.
model WebhookEndpoint {
  id           String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId  String            @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  url          String
  secretEnc    String            @map("secret_enc")
  /// A9.7: the previous secret during a rotation window. When set, outbound deliveries sign
  /// with BOTH secrets (the verifier picks whichever matches — see verifySignature's multi-v1
  /// support in lib/webhook-signature.ts). Cleared once the customer has rolled their receiver
  /// over. Null when no rotation is in flight.
  previousSecretEnc String?      @map("previous_secret_enc")
  /// When the previous secret was set, so a caller can show "rotation started X ago" and a
  /// scheduled job can auto-expire ancient dual-active windows.
  previousSecretRotatedAt DateTime? @map("previous_secret_rotated_at")
  events       String[]          @default([])
  status       String            @default("active")
  failureCount Int               @default(0) @map("failure_count")
  createdById  String?           @map("created_by_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt    DateTime          @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime          @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace    Workspace         @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  deliveries   WebhookDelivery[]

  @@index([workspaceId])
  @@map("webhook_endpoints")
}

/// One attempt-tracked delivery of one event to one endpoint. This row IS the queue row, following
/// the StripeWebhookEvent precedent rather than reusing DocumentProcessingJob (whose 14-minute lease
/// and documentId-shaped drain are wrong here). Claimed with a short lease and drained by the shared
/// driver (after() kick, the internal jobs route, and the worker loop) — see lib/webhook-delivery.ts.
///
/// `eventId` is stable across retries of the same event and is the receiver's idempotency key.
/// `payload` is snapshotted at emission and re-sent verbatim on every retry; receivers re-fetch
/// fresh state via the API link in the payload. workspaceId is carried directly (not only via the
/// endpoint) so the row is scopeable for the settings list and for the RLS policy.
model WebhookDelivery {
  id             String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId    String          @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  endpointId     String          @map("endpoint_id") @db.Uuid
  eventId        String          @map("event_id")
  eventType      String          @map("event_type")
  documentId     String?         @map("document_id") @db.Uuid
  payload        Json
  status         String          @default("pending")
  attempts       Int             @default(0)
  nextAttemptAt  DateTime        @default(now()) @map("next_attempt_at")
  leaseUntil     DateTime?       @map("lease_until")
  responseStatus Int?            @map("response_status")
  errorCode      String?         @map("error_code")
  deliveredAt    DateTime?       @map("delivered_at")
  createdAt      DateTime        @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime        @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  endpoint       WebhookEndpoint @relation(fields: [endpointId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  document       Document?       @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  workspace      Workspace       @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([status, nextAttemptAt])
  @@index([workspaceId, createdAt])
  @@index([endpointId])
  @@map("webhook_deliveries")
}

/// A connected accounting provider (P2): one QuickBooks or Xero connection per workspace. Tokens
/// are AES-GCM-sealed (lib/secret-crypto.ts), exactly like WebhookEndpoint.secretEnc, and never
/// selected in a list query — see models/integrations.ts. `defaultExpenseAccountId`/Name is the one
/// expense account every pushed bill's line items are coded to (scope: one account per connection,
/// no per-line mapping). `status` moves to "needs_reauth" when a refresh fails with an auth-shaped
/// error (lib/integration-token-refresh.ts), which is what the settings UI and the push affordance
/// both check before attempting a push.
model IntegrationConnection {
  id                        String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId               String            @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  provider                  String
  externalTenantId          String?           @map("external_tenant_id")
  tenantName                String?           @map("tenant_name")
  accessTokenEnc            String            @map("access_token_enc")
  refreshTokenEnc           String            @map("refresh_token_enc")
  accessTokenExpiresAt      DateTime?         @map("access_token_expires_at")
  refreshTokenExpiresAt     DateTime?         @map("refresh_token_expires_at")
  scope                     String?
  defaultExpenseAccountId   String?           @map("default_expense_account_id")
  defaultExpenseAccountName String?           @map("default_expense_account_name")
  status                    String            @default("active")
  createdById               String?           @map("created_by_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt                 DateTime          @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt                 DateTime          @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace                 Workspace         @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdBy                 User?             @relation("IntegrationConnectionCreator", fields: [createdById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  pushes                    IntegrationPush[]
  accountingEntities        AccountingEntity[]
  ledgerTransactions        LedgerTransaction[]
  categoryAccountMappings   CategoryAccountMapping[]

  @@unique([workspaceId, provider])
  @@map("integration_connections")
}

/// One attempt-tracked push of one document as a bill/invoice to one connection — the queue row,
/// modelled on WebhookDelivery exactly (claim/process/drain trio in lib/integration-push.ts), but
/// with its own smaller attempt cap (5, not 8; see lib/integration-push-policy.ts). `payload` is the
/// normalized bill snapshot (lib/integration-bill-mapping.ts), captured once so a retry re-sends the
/// same facts even if the source document is edited afterward. `externalBillId` is the created
/// record's id at the provider, for a link back out. One push per (document, connection): re-pushing
/// after a document edit reuses the same row via upsert rather than creating a duplicate bill.
model IntegrationPush {
  id            String                @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId   String                @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  connectionId  String                @map("connection_id") @db.Uuid
  documentId    String                @map("document_id") @db.Uuid
  provider      String
  payload       Json
  status        String                @default("pending")
  attempts      Int                   @default(0)
  nextAttemptAt DateTime              @default(now()) @map("next_attempt_at")
  leaseUntil    DateTime?             @map("lease_until")
  externalBillId    String?              @map("external_bill_id")
  externalRecordKind String?            @map("external_record_kind")
  /// A7.2: the client-generated idempotency token sent with the provider create call (QuickBooks
  /// `requestid`, Xero `Idempotency-Key`), so a retry after a timeout can never create the same
  /// bill twice. Fresh per push INTENT: set on enqueue and rotated when a re-push resets the row —
  /// retries of one intent reuse it, a deliberate new push is a new token. Null on legacy rows.
  idempotencyKey String?               @map("idempotency_key")
  errorCode     String?               @map("error_code")
  createdById   String?               @map("created_by_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt     DateTime              @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime              @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  completedAt   DateTime?             @map("completed_at")
  workspace     Workspace             @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  connection    IntegrationConnection @relation(fields: [connectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  document      Document              @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdBy     User?                 @relation("IntegrationPushCreator", fields: [createdById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([documentId, connectionId])
  @@index([status, nextAttemptAt])
  @@index([workspaceId, createdAt])
  @@map("integration_pushes")
}

/// Bigcapital, unlike QuickBooks/Xero, has no OAuth app to connect through — every workspace gets
/// its own isolated Bigcapital organization, auto-provisioned via a real Bigcapital user account
/// created on the workspace's behalf. This is that account: ONE PER WORKSPACE, not per DocuBite
/// user — confirmed live against a real Bigcapital instance that an account can build exactly one
/// organization, ever (a second build on the same account fails with TENANT_ALREADY_BUILT), so
/// reusing one login across a user's several workspaces (the original P1 design) is not possible.
/// `email` is a `+ws_<workspaceId>` alias of the triggering user's real address (see
/// models/bigcapital.ts's buildAliasEmail) — a distinct, valid, traceable login per workspace.
/// `organizationId` is fixed forever once signup succeeds, well before the org's database is built.
/// `passwordEnc`/`masterTokenEnc` are AES-GCM-sealed exactly like IntegrationConnection's tokens;
/// the JWT is cached only long enough to build an org and mint its API key, never relied on after.
model BigcapitalAccount {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId      String   @unique @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  userId           String   @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  bigcapitalUserId String?  @map("bigcapital_user_id")
  organizationId   String?  @map("organization_id")
  email            String
  passwordEnc      String   @map("password_enc")
  masterTokenEnc   String?  @map("master_token_enc")
  status           String   @default("active")
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace        Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user             User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("bigcapital_accounts")
}

model BigcapitalMemberAccount {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId      String   @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  userId           String   @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  bigcapitalUserId String?  @map("bigcapital_user_id")
  email            String
  passwordEnc      String   @map("password_enc")
  status           String   @default("active")
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace        Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user             User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([workspaceId, userId])
  @@map("bigcapital_member_accounts")
}

/// One durable, retried attempt to provision a workspace's Bigcapital organization (build org +
/// mint API key + seal into an IntegrationConnection) — modelled on IntegrationPush's claim/attempt/
/// drain shape exactly, but keyed on (workspaceId, provider) instead of a document, since there is
/// no per-document unit of work here. Enqueued right after workspace creation; the worker never
/// blocks the request that created it — see models/bigcapital.ts.
model IntegrationProvisionJob {
  id            String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId   String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  provider      String    @default("bigcapital")
  /// The user whose identity backs this provisioning attempt, captured once when the job is
  /// (re)enqueued rather than re-resolved from the workspace's CURRENT owner on every retry — a
  /// team workspace's ownership can change between enqueue and a backoff-delayed retry, and the
  /// job must keep provisioning under the owner who actually triggered it.
  ownerUserId   String?   @map("owner_user_id") @db.Uuid
  /// The in-flight Bigcapital organization-build job id, persisted across attempts so a retry after
  /// a "still building" timeout polls the SAME build instead of kicking off a second one. Cleared
  /// on success or a terminal (non-retryable) failure.
  externalRef   String?   @map("external_ref")
  status        String    @default("pending")
  attempts      Int       @default(0)
  nextAttemptAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("next_attempt_at")
  leaseUntil    DateTime? @map("lease_until")
  errorCode     String?   @map("error_code")
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  completedAt   DateTime? @map("completed_at")
  workspace     Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  ownerUser     User?     @relation("IntegrationProvisionJobOwner", fields: [ownerUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([workspaceId, provider])
  @@index([status, nextAttemptAt])
  @@map("integration_provision_jobs")
}

/** One workspace's tax configuration: which region it files in, versioned the same way
 * DocumentTemplate is (currentVersion + immutable TaxProfileVersion rows) so a rate change never
 * rewrites what an already-extracted document was checked against. One per workspace — accounting
 * mode's WP4; Phase 1's only consumers are currency/prompt hints, with WP12's tax-consistency
 * check as the reason the rate-with-effective-date shape exists at all (lib/tax/regions.ts). */
model TaxProfile {
  id             String              @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId    String              @unique @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  /// "za" | "ls" | "gb" | "us" — see types/product-mode.ts's sibling, lib/tax/regions.ts's
  /// TAX_REGIONS registry.
  region         String
  currentVersion Int                 @default(1) @map("current_version")
  createdAt      DateTime            @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime            @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace      Workspace           @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  versions       TaxProfileVersion[]

  @@map("tax_profiles")
}

/// Immutable snapshot of one TaxRegionConfig (lib/tax/regions.ts), the version a document's tax
/// check (WP12) is run against. Never updated in place — a region or rate change creates a new
/// version and bumps TaxProfile.currentVersion, exactly like DocumentTemplateVersion.
model TaxProfileVersion {
  id        String     @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  profileId String     @map("profile_id") @db.Uuid
  version   Int
  config    Json
  createdAt DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  profile   TaxProfile @relation(fields: [profileId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([profileId, version])
  @@map("tax_profile_versions")
}

/** One deterministic check's result for one document (WP12) — a table, not a Json bag on
 * Document, so both the review queue and analytics can query "every failing arithmetic check this
 * month" without deserialising every document's blob to find out. `@@unique([documentId,
 * checkCode])` makes re-running checks (a reprocess, a rule correction that changes coding) an
 * upsert rather than an ever-growing history — each check's LATEST verdict is what matters here;
 * DocumentAuditEvent is where the history of what changed actually lives. */
model DocumentCheckResult {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  documentId  String    @map("document_id") @db.Uuid
  /// invoice_arithmetic | statement_balance | duplicate | missing_statement_period |
  /// tax_consistency | suspicious_resubmission | vat_number_format | statement_layout_drift
  checkCode   String    @map("check_code")
  /// pass | warn | fail | escalated
  status      String
  message     String
  detail      Json?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  document    Document  @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  /// #210 (Wayfinder map 177): the escalation lifecycle for a check a reviewer flagged as "the
  /// document is wrong" (`status: "escalated"`), separate from `status` — `status` is the check's
  /// own pass/warn/fail/escalated evaluation, these fields are the Exceptions queue's work state
  /// on top of it. Deliberately not a Gate row: Gate is unique per (documentId, gateType), one row
  /// per document per runner, which can't express "one row per escalated check" when a document
  /// has several escalated checks at once. Null until a check is escalated.
  /// open (unassigned) | in_review (picked up) | resolved
  escalationStatus         String?   @map("escalation_status")
  escalationAssigneeId     String?   @map("escalation_assignee_id") @db.Uuid
  /// corrected | vendor_accepted | false_positive — set together with escalationResolvedAt/By.
  escalationResolution     String?   @map("escalation_resolution")
  escalationResolutionNote String?   @map("escalation_resolution_note")
  escalationResolvedById   String?   @map("escalation_resolved_by_id") @db.Uuid
  escalationResolvedAt     DateTime? @map("escalation_resolved_at")
  escalationAssignee       User?     @relation("CheckResultEscalationAssignee", fields: [escalationAssigneeId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  escalationResolvedBy     User?     @relation("CheckResultEscalationResolver", fields: [escalationResolvedById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([documentId, checkCode])
  @@index([workspaceId, status])
  /// The Exceptions queue's read: every open/in-review escalation in this workspace.
  @@index([workspaceId, escalationStatus])
  @@map("document_check_results")
}

/** A supplier automation rule (WP11): "when this document's supplier/merchant matches this way,
 * on these template codes, apply this coding" — the engine itself is pure (lib/automation/rules.ts
 * applyRules), this is only its data. `matcher` and `actions` are Json rather than columns because
 * the shape is genuinely open-ended (which fields a rule sets varies by template), and because a
 * hand-rolled matcher/action DSL evolving is a data change here, not a migration, exactly like
 * DocumentTemplate's own field DSL.
 *
 * matcher: { type: "exact" | "contains", value: string, templateCodes?: string[] }
 * actions: { codingData: Record<string, string | number>, defaults?: Record<string, unknown> }
 *
 * hitCount is incremented every time applyRules picks this rule for a document — the "hit stats"
 * the settings/rules UI shows. Editing a rule (the reviewer "update rule" correction flow, WP11)
 * only ever affects documents extracted AFTER the edit; already-applied documents are untouched,
 * which is why the rule itself carries no history of what it used to say. */
model AutomationRule {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId    String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  name           String
  matcher        Json
  actions        Json
  /// A match below this confidence on the matched field still applies the rule's coding, but
  /// also raises requireReview regardless of the rule's own flag — a low-confidence supplier read
  /// matching a rule is exactly the case a person should glance at before trusting the coding.
  minConfidence  Float?    @map("min_confidence")
  requireReview  Boolean   @default(false) @map("require_review")
  /// Part 5b (autopublish): when true, a document this rule codes with requireReview=false is
  /// pushed to the workspace's connected accounting provider automatically — see
  /// lib/automation/autopublish.ts. False by default: autopublish is something a supplier rule
  /// opts into, not a surprise a rule silently starts doing.
  autopublish    Boolean   @default(false)
  isActive       Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  hitCount       Int       @default(0) @map("hit_count")
  createdById    String?   @map("created_by_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace      Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdBy      User?     @relation("AutomationRuleCreator", fields: [createdById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  appliedTo      Document[]

  @@index([workspaceId, isActive])
  @@map("automation_rules")
}

/** One row per module a workspace has ever touched (lib/modules) — "always"-tier core modules
 * never need a row (they're on for every workspace of their industry unconditionally); this table
 * only exists to record deviations from a module's default state, plus optional-tier requests.
 *
 * status: "enabled" | "disabled" | "requested" (lib/modules/capabilities.ts's resolveModules reads
 * these as overrides against the industry's default set — a "requested" row adds no capability by
 * itself, it just gives the catalog page something to show an owner). source distinguishes an
 * owner's own toggle ("user") from a support/admin override ("admin") for the catalog's audit trail;
 * "default" is unused today (reserved for a future explicit-seed row) but kept in the type union
 * documented at the call site in lib/modules/capabilities.ts.
 *
 * requestedById is nullable/SetNull rather than Cascade: a member who requested a module and later
 * left the workspace shouldn't take the request's provenance with them. */
model WorkspaceModule {
  id            String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId   String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  moduleKey     String    @map("module_key")
  status        String
  source        String    @default("user")
  requestedById String?   @map("requested_by_id") @db.Uuid
  note          String?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace     Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  requestedBy   User?     @relation("ModuleRequester", fields: [requestedById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([workspaceId, moduleKey])
  @@map("workspace_modules")
}

/** One item of work in the accounting review queue (WP10): a document that needs a person to
 * look at it, and why. `reason` is what WP11 (automation rules) and WP12 (deterministic checks)
 * will create these for automatically — "manual" is the only reason a person can create one today,
 * since nothing else populates the queue until those land. Every status transition writes a
 * DocumentAuditEvent (models/review-tasks.ts) — this is the reviewed history WP11's correction
 * flow must never rewrite, only append to.
 *
 * ReviewComment and ReviewSavedFilter (also named in the roadmap) are deliberately not built yet:
 * the roadmap itself defers them as follow-ups once table+detail+bulk actions are shipped and in
 * use — adding their schema now with no UI to exercise it would be undertested surface. */
model ReviewTask {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId  String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  documentId   String    @map("document_id") @db.Uuid
  /// open | in_review | approved | rejected
  status       String    @default("open")
  /// manual | low_confidence | rule_required | check_failed
  reason       String    @default("manual")
  assigneeId   String?   @map("assignee_id") @db.Uuid
  /// Free text: what a rule or check found, or a note from whoever flagged it manually.
  detail       String?
  priority     Int       @default(0)
  dueAt        DateTime? @map("due_at")
  createdById  String?   @map("created_by_id") @db.Uuid
  /// Dext-parity Phase 3 WP3.1: null for a plain single-decision task (the pre-existing behavior —
  /// approve/reject settles it immediately). Set when the task was created against an
  /// ApprovalWorkflow, in which case `status` only reaches "approved" once `currentStageIndex` has
  /// cleared every stage — see lib/approvals/engine.ts and models/review-tasks.ts.
  workflowId   String?   @map("workflow_id") @db.Uuid
  /// Index into the workflow's stages, 0-based. Null whenever workflowId is null. Advances by one
  /// on each stage approval; a rejection at any stage is terminal regardless of index.
  currentStageIndex Int? @map("current_stage_index")
  /// Dext-parity Phase 3 WP3.4: when a reminder email was last sent for this task, so
  /// lib/reminders.ts never re-sends inside its repeat window. Null until the first one goes out.
  lastReminderAt DateTime? @map("last_reminder_at")
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  resolvedAt   DateTime? @map("resolved_at")
  workspace    Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  document     Document  @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  assignee     User?     @relation("ReviewTaskAssignee", fields: [assigneeId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  createdBy    User?     @relation("ReviewTaskCreator", fields: [createdById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  workflow     ApprovalWorkflow? @relation(fields: [workflowId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([workspaceId, status, createdAt])
  @@index([workspaceId, assigneeId, status])
  @@index([documentId])
  @@index([workflowId])
  @@map("review_tasks")
}

/// Data Health Phase A: one open (or since-decided) finding produced by a lib/health/checks/*
/// check run — the workspace-wide analogue of DocumentCheckResult, which is per-document and
/// per-check-run rather than dedupe-and-persist. `fingerprint` is the app-computed dedupe key
/// (`${checkCode}:${documentId ?? ""}:${externalTransactionId ?? ""}`), kept as its own column
/// rather than a compound `@@unique([workspaceId, checkCode, documentId, externalTransactionId])`
/// because Postgres treats NULLs as distinct in a unique index — two rows that are both
/// `(checkCode, null, null)` would NOT collide under a compound unique, silently defeating the
/// dedupe. A single computed string column sidesteps that entirely.
///
/// category is always "pipeline" in Phase A (the only category any check here belongs to);
/// "cleanup" | "tax" | "activity" are later phases' categories, kept in the column comment so the
/// UI's sidebar nav (components/health/health-sidebar-nav.tsx) already knows the full set to render.
model HealthCheckResult {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  /// e.g. review_backlog | push_failures | confidence_drift | uncorrected_low_confidence |
  /// rule_coverage | stale_documents — see lib/health/registry.ts.
  checkCode   String    @map("check_code")
  /// cleanup | pipeline | tax | activity — Phase A only ever writes "pipeline".
  category    String
  /// critical | warning | info
  severity    String
  /// open | dismissed | resolved
  status      String    @default("open")
  title       String
  description String
  fingerprint String
  documentId  String?   @map("document_id") @db.Uuid
  /// Always null in Phase A — no ledger/transaction table exists yet. Column exists for later
  /// phases' ledger-reconciliation checks.
  externalTransactionId String? @map("external_transaction_id")
  suggestedAction        String? @map("suggested_action")
  suggestedActionPayload Json?   @map("suggested_action_payload")
  /// Set by runHealthChecks' own auto-resolve pass (a check ran and no longer produced this
  /// fingerprint) — distinct from a person dismissing a finding, which sets dismissedAt instead.
  resolvedAt     DateTime? @map("resolved_at")
  resolvedById   String?   @map("resolved_by_id") @db.Uuid
  resolvedAction String?   @map("resolved_action")
  dismissedAt    DateTime? @map("dismissed_at")
  dismissedById  String?   @map("dismissed_by_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace      Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  document       Document? @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  resolvedBy     User?     @relation("HealthCheckResultResolver", fields: [resolvedById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  dismissedBy    User?     @relation("HealthCheckResultDismisser", fields: [dismissedById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([workspaceId, fingerprint])
  @@index([workspaceId, status, category])
  @@index([workspaceId, checkCode])
  @@map("health_check_results")
}

/// Data Health Phase A: one append-only daily snapshot of a workspace's overall health score
/// (lib/health/score.ts's computeHealthScore), written by computeAndSnapshotHealthScore. Unique on
/// (workspaceId, computedOn) so re-running the snapshot the same day updates in place rather than
/// accumulating duplicate same-day rows — the sparkline reads one point per day, not one per run.
model HealthScore {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  computedOn  DateTime  @map("computed_on") @db.Date
  score       Float
  /// CheckScoreBreakdownEntry[] from lib/health/score.ts — per-check score/weight/counts, so the
  /// UI can explain "why" a score is what it is without recomputing it.
  breakdown   Json
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([workspaceId, computedOn])
  @@index([workspaceId, computedOn])
  @@map("health_scores")
}

/// Data Health Phase A: a per-workspace override of one check's enabled/weight state, read by
/// lib/health/score.ts's computeHealthScore (falls back to the check's own CheckDefinition.defaultWeight
/// when no row exists here, or when weight is null). No row means "use the check's own defaults" —
/// most workspaces never need one.
model HealthScoreConfig {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String   @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  checkCode   String   @map("check_code")
  enabled     Boolean  @default(true)
  /// Null means "use the check's own defaultWeight".
  weight      Float?
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([workspaceId, checkCode])
  @@map("health_score_configs")
}

/// Dext-parity Phase 3 WP3.1: a named, ordered sequence of approval stages a workspace can attach
/// to a ReviewTask (via ReviewTask.workflowId) instead of the plain single-decision default. Stage
/// gating is a role check, not a per-stage approver list; the reviewer role now exists on
/// WorkspaceMember (see models/workspaces.ts's WorkspaceRole, "owner" | "reviewer" | "member") but
/// approval workflows keep the simpler "any signed-in member, or an owner if sensitive" model —
/// so a stage that needs to be sensitive marks itself ApprovalWorkflowStage.requireOwner rather
/// than naming specific approvers or requiring the reviewer capability, which is used only by
/// the SMB-vs-firm workspace-mode derivation (decision #41). `active: false` retires a workflow
/// without deleting it — existing ReviewTask rows still pointing at it keep working (workflowId
/// is a plain FK, not filtered by active), it just stops being offered for new tasks.
model ApprovalWorkflow {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  name        String
  active      Boolean   @default(true)
  createdById String?   @map("created_by_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdBy   User?     @relation("ApprovalWorkflowCreator", fields: [createdById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  stages      ApprovalWorkflowStage[]
  reviewTasks ReviewTask[]
  expenseClaims ExpenseClaim[]

  @@index([workspaceId, active])
  @@map("approval_workflows")
}

/// One stage of an ApprovalWorkflow, in `stageIndex` order (0-based, unique per workflow). The
/// engine (lib/approvals/engine.ts) only ever reads a stage by its workflow + index, never by id,
/// so there is deliberately no separate "current stage" foreign key on ReviewTask — just the index.
model ApprovalWorkflowStage {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workflowId  String   @map("workflow_id") @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String   @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  stageIndex  Int      @map("stage_index")
  name        String
  /// When true, only a workspace "owner" (not a plain "member") can approve this stage — see
  /// models/workspaces.ts's WorkspaceRole. False means any workspace member can.
  requireOwner Boolean @default(false) @map("require_owner")
  /// WP-AP2: per-stage named approvers. When non-empty, the stage can only be decided by one of
  /// these users (rather than by "any member" or "any owner"). Empty keeps the historic role-only
  /// behavior. The engine's canDecideStage honors both — see lib/approvals/engine.ts.
  approverIds String[] @default([]) @map("approver_ids") @db.Uuid
  /// WP-AP2: amount threshold. When non-null, a bill under this amount SKIPS the stage — a
  /// caller building the stage list for one document should call applicableStages() to filter.
  /// Money-typed for the same reason ExpenseClaim.total is: chained Float arithmetic drifts and
  /// this is compared against ledger amounts. Null = the stage applies at every amount.
  minAmount   Decimal? @map("min_amount") @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  workflow    ApprovalWorkflow @relation(fields: [workflowId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([workflowId, stageIndex])
  @@index([workspaceId])
  @@map("approval_workflow_stages")
}

/// Dext-parity Phase 3 WP3.3: an employee's expense claim, grouping one or more `expense_receipt`
/// Documents (via ExpenseClaimItem) under one submitter/status/total. Deliberately its own
/// top-level entity rather than a ReviewTask: `ReviewTask.documentId` is a required, non-nullable
/// FK to a single `Document`, and a Document is always the product of one uploaded file going
/// through OCR/extraction (`Document.fileId` is required — see models/documents.ts) — there is no
/// way to make a claim's own metadata (submitter, title, claim date) itself a Document without
/// fighting that invariant everywhere else in the codebase. Instead this reuses only the
/// lower-level ApprovalWorkflow/ApprovalWorkflowStage tables and lib/approvals/engine.ts's pure
/// decideStage/canDecideStage functions directly, via its own workflowId/currentStageIndex pair —
/// the exact same shape ReviewTask.workflowId/currentStageIndex already use, just on a claim
/// instead of a review task.
///
/// `submitterId` is nullable with ON DELETE SET NULL, not the `WorkspaceInvitation.sentById`-style
/// required-Cascade some other "who did this" FKs use: an expense claim is a financial record that
/// should survive a departed employee's account being removed, the same reasoning ReviewTask's
/// assigneeId/createdById are SetNull rather than Cascade.
model ExpenseClaim {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  submitterId String?   @map("submitter_id") @db.Uuid
  title       String?
  /// draft | submitted | approved | rejected — same shape as ReviewTask.status, "draft" standing
  /// in for ReviewTask's "open" (not yet sent for a decision) and "submitted" for "in_review".
  status      String    @default("draft")
  /// The sum of each linked receipt's own `total` (from Document.reviewedData), frozen at the
  /// moment the claim was submitted — not a live recompute. Null while still a draft. A snapshot
  /// so approving a claim later never silently changes what it says a person is owed just because
  /// a linked receipt's extracted total got corrected afterward — same freeze-at-the-moment
  /// philosophy as Document.fieldSnapshot. Decimal(18,2) since Phase 1: chained Float arithmetic
  /// on money drifts (0.1 + 0.2 = 0.30000000000000004) and this column is compared against pushed
  /// ledger totals during reconciliation. See lib/money.ts for the boundary helpers that convert
  /// Prisma's Decimal.js instance back to `number` at read sites — the app layer still speaks
  /// plain `number | null` above the DB.
  total       Decimal? @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  currencyCode String?  @map("currency_code")
  workflowId  String?   @map("workflow_id") @db.Uuid
  currentStageIndex Int? @map("current_stage_index")
  submittedAt DateTime? @map("submitted_at")
  resolvedAt  DateTime? @map("resolved_at")
  /// Dext-parity Phase 3 WP3.4: mirrors ReviewTask.lastReminderAt — when a reminder email was
  /// last sent for this claim, so lib/reminders.ts never re-sends inside its repeat window.
  lastReminderAt DateTime? @map("last_reminder_at")
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  submitter   User?     @relation("ExpenseClaimSubmitter", fields: [submitterId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  workflow    ApprovalWorkflow? @relation(fields: [workflowId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  items       ExpenseClaimItem[]

  @@index([workspaceId, status, createdAt])
  @@index([workspaceId, submitterId])
  @@index([workflowId])
  @@map("expense_claims")
}

/// Join row linking one ExpenseClaim to one of its receipt Documents. A plain join table, not a
/// richer relation, because there is nothing claim-item-specific to store beyond the link itself —
/// the amount lives on the Document's own reviewedData, and ExpenseClaim.total is the frozen sum
/// computed from those at submission (see its own doc-comment).
model ExpenseClaimItem {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  claimId     String   @map("claim_id") @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String   @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  documentId  String   @map("document_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  claim       ExpenseClaim @relation(fields: [claimId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  document    Document @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([claimId, documentId])
  @@index([workspaceId])
  @@index([documentId])
  @@map("expense_claim_items")
}

/** A durable record of one accepted upload, independent of the Document it produces (WP9).
 *
 * Two things a Document row cannot give the intake layer on its own: an idempotency key that
 * exists BEFORE a Document is created (so a provider retry of the same bytes — a re-sent email,
 * a re-uploaded ZIP — is recognised at the door, without the malware scan and extraction a second
 * Document would cost), and a status ledger that survives across every intake channel (upload,
 * camera, email, zip, api) uniformly, which is what a batch progress panel polls.
 *
 * Wraps DocumentProcessingJob rather than replacing it: extraction retry/backoff still lives
 * there (lib/document-processing.ts); this only tracks whether the item ever became a Document at
 * all, and if not, why (rejected by malware scan, or a duplicate of one already ingested into the
 * same file). attempts/nextRetryAt mirror the WebhookDelivery/IntegrationPush shape for a future
 * ingestion-level retry (e.g. a transient malware-scan outage); nothing drains them yet — every
 * ingestion attempt today is synchronous within the request/action that created this row. */
model IngestionItem {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId    String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  fileId         String    @map("file_id") @db.Uuid
  documentId     String?   @map("document_id") @db.Uuid
  /// upload | camera | email | zip | api
  source         String
  /// sha256 of the raw bytes. Unique per (workspace, file) — deliberately the same scope as
  /// Document's own (fileId, sha256) constraint, so the two layers agree instead of contradicting
  /// each other. It was workspace-wide until 2026-09-06; that scope ran first and short-circuited,
  /// which made Document's per-file rule unreachable and silently blocked the case that rule
  /// exists to allow (the same PDF deliberately extracted into two sheets with different columns).
  /// Retry idempotency is unaffected: every automated intake path resolves to a fixed fileId — a
  /// re-sent email always lands in the workspace's "Email intake" file (ensureEmailIntakeFile) —
  /// so a provider retry still collides on this key exactly as before.
  idempotencyKey String    @map("idempotency_key")
  /// pending | clean | infected | scan_failed
  malwareStatus  String    @default("pending") @map("malware_status")
  /// received | rejected | duplicate | extracting | extracted | failed
  status         String    @default("received")
  attempts       Int       @default(0)
  nextRetryAt    DateTime? @map("next_retry_at")
  errorCode      String?   @map("error_code")
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace      Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  document       Document? @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([workspaceId, fileId, idempotencyKey])
  @@index([workspaceId, createdAt])
  @@index([documentId])
  @@map("ingestion_items")
}

/** First-party product analytics (WP5) — no third-party SDK, on the theory that a HIPAA-safe
 * event store has to be this app's own database rather than handed to an outside analytics
 * vendor. `props` is validated at the point of writing (lib/analytics.ts's per-event zod schemas,
 * not here) to keep document content, filenames, and free text out of it by construction — this
 * table is read for aggregate rollups (admin console), never for identifying what one customer's
 * document said.
 *
 * workspaceId is nullable and this is NOT in WORKSPACE_SCOPED_MODELS: the admin rollups this
 * exists for read across every workspace by design, the same reasoning as StripeWebhookEvent and
 * AdminAuditEvent. onDelete: SetNull, not Cascade — a deleted workspace's history should not
 * silently distort a rollup that already counted it. */
model ProductEvent {
  id          String     @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String?    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  actorId     String?    @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  name        String
  props       Json
  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  workspace   Workspace? @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  actor       User?      @relation("ProductEventActor", fields: [actorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([workspaceId, createdAt])
  @@index([name, createdAt])
  @@map("product_events")
}

/** F16: the third parties that can receive customer document content or metadata, and whether a
 * BAA is in place with each. HIPAA S164.308(b)(1) requires a signed BAA with every Business
 * Associate that touches ePHI -- this is the register that makes "who has a BAA" answerable
 * without re-deriving it from the codebase every time. Browsable read-only in /admin-next; kept
 * current by whoever runs the BAA process, not by code (see docs/security). */
model Subprocessor {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  name          String   @unique
  /// What the processor is used for, in plain language -- "OCR of uploaded document images".
  purpose       String
  /// What of the customer's data it actually receives -- "document text and page images", not
  /// just "documents", so a reviewer can judge exposure without reading the code.
  dataReceived  String   @map("data_received")
  /// "not_started" | "in_progress" | "signed" | "not_applicable" (no PHI reaches this processor).
  /// A String, not an enum, matching User.role and DocumentAuditEvent.type elsewhere in this
  /// schema -- the set of states is a data concern, not a migration concern.
  baaStatus     String   @default("not_started") @map("baa_status")
  region        String?
  notes         String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@map("subprocessors")
}

/** F14: a fixed-window rate-limit counter, in this app's own database rather than Supabase's.
 * Backstops Supabase Auth's built-in rate limiter, which has an open report of not always being
 * enforced (supabase/auth#2333) — see lib/rate-limit.ts and the HIPAA migration plan's
 * Verification section. Scoped to password-reset and signup, the two paths that run through a
 * server action of ours and so can be checked before ever calling Supabase.
 *
 * One row per (key, windowStart) rather than a single mutable counter reset on read: this way a
 * concurrent burst of requests all landing in the same window race on the same unique constraint
 * and Postgres itself serializes the increments — no read-modify-write gap to exploit. */
model AuthRateLimit {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  /// "<action>:<identifier>" — e.g. "password_reset:203.0.113.4" or "signup:203.0.113.4".
  key         String
  windowStart DateTime @map("window_start")
  count       Int      @default(1)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  @@unique([key, windowStart])
  @@index([windowStart])
  @@map("auth_rate_limits")
}

/// WP1.4: widens the inbound-email sender allowlist (models/inbound-email.ts's isSenderAllowed)
/// beyond "already a workspace member" to explicitly-added addresses or whole domains — a
/// bookkeeper's own inbox, say. `pattern` is either a lowercased exact email or a lowercased
/// "@domain.tld" suffix; matching is done in application code (matchesAllowPattern), not SQL.
model InboundEmailAllowedSender {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  pattern     String
  createdById String?   @map("created_by_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdBy   User?     @relation("InboundEmailAllowedSenderCreator", fields: [createdById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([workspaceId, pattern])
  @@map("inbound_email_allowed_senders")
}

/// WP1.3: the few-shot correction memory — every time a reviewer overrides an extracted value, the
/// (wrong, corrected) pair is remembered per (workspace, template, field) and fed back into future
/// extraction prompts as format guidance (lib/document-templates.ts's buildDocumentPrompt). A repeat
/// of the exact same correction bumps hitCount rather than creating a new row — the same "the
/// LATEST/most-reinforced state is what matters, not the whole history" shape as DocumentCheckResult.
model FieldCorrection {
  id            String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId   String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  templateCode  String    @map("template_code")
  fieldKey      String    @map("field_key")
  /// The document's supplier/merchant/payee at the time of correction (lib/automation/rules.ts's
  /// SUPPLIER_FIELD_BY_TEMPLATE), kept for future supplier-scoped retrieval — not used by
  /// getFewShotExamples's current top-N-by-hitCount selection.
  supplier      String?
  wrongValue    String    @map("wrong_value")
  correctedValue String   @map("corrected_value")
  hitCount      Int       @default(1) @map("hit_count")
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace     Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([workspaceId, templateCode, fieldKey, wrongValue, correctedValue])
  @@index([workspaceId, templateCode, fieldKey, updatedAt])
  @@map("field_corrections")
}

/// AI coding fallback: same shape as FieldCorrection but keyed on coding keys (account, taxCode,
/// costCentre) rather than extraction fields. When a reviewer overrides an AI-suggested coding, the
/// diff is recorded here and fed into future coding-agent prompts to prevent the same mistake.
model CodingCorrection {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId    String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  templateCode   String    @map("template_code")
  supplier       String?
  codingKey      String    @map("coding_key")
  wrongValue     String    @map("wrong_value")
  correctedValue String    @map("corrected_value")
  hitCount       Int       @default(1) @map("hit_count")
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace      Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([workspaceId, templateCode, codingKey, wrongValue, correctedValue])
  @@index([workspaceId, templateCode])
  @@map("coding_corrections")
}

/// WP1.5: a synced snapshot of one QuickBooks/Xero entity (account, vendor, or tax rate) — powers
/// the rules UI's account picker (WP1.6) without a live provider round-trip on every page render.
/// `externalId` is the provider's id (QuickBooks Account.Id / Xero Account.Code, etc.); `active`
/// tracks the provider's own active flag so a deactivated account drops out of pickers without
/// losing the sync history. `raw` is the provider's row as fetched, for fields not worth a column yet.
model AccountingEntity {
  id           String              @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId  String              @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  connectionId String              @map("connection_id") @db.Uuid
  /// "account" | "vendor" | "tax_rate"
  entityType   String              @map("entity_type")
  externalId   String              @map("external_id")
  code         String?
  name         String
  active       Boolean             @default(true)
  raw          Json?
  syncedAt     DateTime            @map("synced_at")
  workspace    Workspace           @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  connection   IntegrationConnection @relation(fields: [connectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([connectionId, entityType, externalId])
  @@index([workspaceId, entityType, name])
  @@map("accounting_entities")
}

/// Phase B: explicit category-to-account mapping for accounting push — overrides the inferred
/// map from getCategoryAccountMap (models/integrations.ts) when a workspace owner configures
/// a category to always use a specific expense/income account.
model CategoryAccountMapping {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId       String   @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  connectionId      String   @map("connection_id") @db.Uuid
  category          String
  kind              String   @default("expense")
  accountExternalId String   @map("account_external_id")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace         Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  connection        IntegrationConnection @relation(fields: [connectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([connectionId, category, kind])
  @@index([workspaceId])
  @@map("category_account_mappings")
}

/// #83: workspace-scoped goods-vs-services classification for the free-form category strings on
/// bills. The LS VAT-12 return-form workpaper (#85) splits inputs by goods × services × deferred,
/// and this side table is what makes that split possible without turning `category` into a first-
/// class model. Mirrors the shape of CategoryAccountMapping — string category key + workspace
/// scope + unique on (workspaceId, category). No back-fill: rows land only as workspaces set
/// them during LS onboarding; a bill whose category has no row (and no per-bill override) projects
/// with `WorkpaperBill.isService = null` and silent-passes return-form columns per #82's contract.
model CategoryNature {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String   @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  category    String
  /// "goods" | "services". Kept as a String rather than an enum to match the codebase's
  /// convention for small closed sets that grow by data (Workspace.role, TaxProfile.rates, …).
  nature      String
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([workspaceId, category])
  @@index([workspaceId])
  @@map("category_natures")
}

/// Data Health Phase B: one bill / expense / bank-transaction row pulled from an
/// IntegrationConnection's provider by lib/health/sync.ts's syncLedgerTransactions — the local
/// cache the cleanup-category health checks (lib/health/checks/*, see lib/health/registry.ts)
/// read from, mirroring how AccountingEntity caches accounts/vendors/tax rates for WP1.5. A row
/// from a prior sync that the provider no longer returns is marked inactive rather than deleted,
/// same soft-retire convention as AccountingEntity/syncAccountingEntities.
model LedgerTransaction {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId       String   @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  connectionId      String   @map("connection_id") @db.Uuid
  externalId        String   @map("external_id")
  /// "bill" | "expense" | "bank_transaction"
  kind              String
  contactExternalId String?  @map("contact_external_id")
  contactName       String?  @map("contact_name")
  accountExternalId String?  @map("account_external_id")
  accountName       String?  @map("account_name")
  docNumber         String?  @map("doc_number")
  /// Decimal(18,2) since Phase 1 — see lib/money.ts. Route reads through decimalToNumber where
  /// the caller expects `number`.
  amount            Decimal? @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  taxAmount         Decimal? @db.Decimal(18, 2) @map("tax_amount")
  currencyCode      String?  @map("currency_code")
  txnDate           DateTime? @db.Date @map("txn_date")
  reconciled        Boolean  @default(false)
  /// "docubite" when this row was reconciled by DocuBite closing a bank-match loop; "provider" when
  /// the upstream ledger reported IsReconciled=true. Null means never reconciled. The sync path
  /// treats a "docubite"-source row as authoritative: an upstream `reconciled: false` never
  /// clobbers it back — only an upstream `true` can flip the source to "provider".
  reconciledSource  String?  @map("reconciled_source")
  active            Boolean  @default(true)
  raw               Json?
  dueAmount         Decimal? @db.Decimal(18, 2) @map("due_amount")
  paidAmount        Decimal? @db.Decimal(18, 2) @map("paid_amount")
  paymentStatus     String?  @map("payment_status")
  syncedAt          DateTime @map("synced_at")
  workspace         Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  connection        IntegrationConnection @relation(fields: [connectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([connectionId, kind, externalId])
  @@index([workspaceId, kind, txnDate])
  @@index([workspaceId, contactExternalId])
  @@map("ledger_transactions")
}

/// WP2.1/WP2.3: one suggested-or-decided match between a line inside a bank/supplier statement
/// document (`transactionIndex` into its reviewedData.transactions array — no projected transaction
/// table; the statement's Document.reviewedData stays the canonical source) and another document in
/// the workspace (an invoice/receipt for `kind: "bank"`, or the statement itself for
/// `kind: "supplier_statement"` matching against invoices). Regenerating suggestions for a statement
/// deletes only its non-accepted rows (models/bank-matches.ts) — an accepted match is a person's
/// decision and survives a re-run.
model BankMatch {
  id                  String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId         String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  statementDocumentId String    @map("statement_document_id") @db.Uuid
  transactionIndex    Int       @map("transaction_index")
  matchedDocumentId   String    @map("matched_document_id") @db.Uuid
  /// "bank" | "supplier_statement"
  kind                String    @default("bank")
  dateDeltaDays       Int?      @map("date_delta_days")
  confidence          Float
  /// "suggested" | "accepted" | "rejected"
  status              String    @default("suggested")
  decidedById         String?   @map("decided_by_id") @db.Uuid
  decidedAt           DateTime? @map("decided_at")
  detail              Json?
  /// Phase 2: nullable FK to the durable StatementLine identity. Non-null once
  /// projectStatementLines has run against the statement. `transactionIndex` stays as the
  /// legacy positional address until every accepted-match row is migrated onto a StatementLine.
  statementLineId     String?   @map("statement_line_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace           Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  statementDocument    Document @relation("BankMatchStatement", fields: [statementDocumentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  matchedDocument      Document @relation("BankMatchMatched", fields: [matchedDocumentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  decidedBy           User?     @relation("BankMatchDecider", fields: [decidedById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  statementLine        StatementLine? @relation(fields: [statementLineId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([workspaceId, kind, statementDocumentId, transactionIndex, matchedDocumentId])
  @@index([workspaceId, statementDocumentId])
  @@index([workspaceId, matchedDocumentId])
  @@index([workspaceId, statementLineId])
  @@map("bank_matches")
}

/// Phase 2: durable identity for one line inside a bank or supplier statement document.
///
/// The statement's Document.reviewedData stays the canonical source of the line's content, but
/// re-extraction reshuffles the underlying `transactions` array and (a) strands accepted
/// BankMatch rows still keyed on the old array index and (b) makes reconciliation a moving
/// target for anything that outlives one extraction pass. `contentHash` is a stable identity
/// over the normalized line (date | amount cents | currency | description) so the same line
/// survives a re-projection under the same id.
model StatementLine {
  id                  String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId         String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  documentId          String    @map("document_id") @db.Uuid
  /// The row's current position in the statement's `transactions` (or `entries`) array, or -1 when
  /// the line has since vanished from the source but is retained because an accepted BankMatch
  /// still points at it (orphaned line, kept for the decision-record).
  lineIndex           Int       @map("line_index")
  /// sha256 of `date|amountCents|currency|description` after normalization (whitespace collapsed,
  /// case-folded description). Genuine duplicate lines (same date, amount, description) get an
  /// app-level `-N` suffix to keep the (documentId, contentHash) uniqueness.
  contentHash         String    @map("content_hash")
  txnDate             DateTime? @db.Date @map("txn_date")
  amount              Decimal?  @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  currencyCode        String?   @map("currency_code")
  description         String?
  counterparty        String?
  /// "debit" | "credit" — direction relative to the statement's owner.
  direction           String?
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace           Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  document            Document  @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  bankMatches         BankMatch[]

  @@unique([documentId, contentHash])
  @@index([workspaceId, txnDate])
  @@index([workspaceId, amount])
  @@map("statement_lines")
}

/// Pipeline redesign: per-user, per-workspace, per-view column/filter/sort preferences for the
/// document pipeline list (Inbox / To review / Ready / Approvals / Archive all share one shell —
/// `viewKey` is what lets each tab remember its own layout). Server-side because a column
/// preference set on one device must survive a switch to another; localStorage cannot do that.
model UserListPreference {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId      String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  viewKey     String    @map("view_key")
  columns     Json
  filters     Json
  sort        Json
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  user        User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, workspaceId, viewKey])
  @@map("user_list_preferences")
}

/// #180/#201: a named, savable set of columns/filters/sort for a list screen (`viewKey`, same
/// vocabulary as `UserListPreference.viewKey` — "invoices", "receipts", ...), separate from
/// `UserListPreference` which stays the unwired per-user "current selection" state. `ownerId: null`
/// means workspace-shared; `isSystem` views are seeded per screen and are not user-editable/-deletable
/// ("Duplicate as new view" forks one into an editable copy instead). `scopeToCurrentUser` expresses
/// a personal-inbox-shaped system view (e.g. "Assigned to me") without a separate concept.
model SavedView {
  id                 String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId        String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  viewKey            String    @map("view_key")
  name               String
  ownerId            String?   @map("owner_id") @db.Uuid
  isSystem           Boolean   @default(false) @map("is_system")
  scopeToCurrentUser Boolean   @default(false) @map("scope_to_current_user")
  columns            Json
  filters            Json
  sort               Json
  createdAt          DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt          DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace          Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  owner              User?     @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([workspaceId, viewKey, name])
  @@index([workspaceId, viewKey])
  @@map("saved_views")
}

/// Cached LLM verdict for policy evaluation, approval context, and match explanation agents.
/// Re-running with the same inputs (inputHash) skips the LLM call entirely.
model AgentVerdict {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  agentKind   String    @map("agent_kind")
  subjectType String    @map("subject_type")
  subjectId   String    @map("subject_id") @db.Uuid
  documentId  String?   @map("document_id") @db.Uuid
  /// Json (not String): each agent kind stores a different shape — coding stores
  /// {codingData, confidence}, policy stores {decision, reasoning}.
  verdict     Json
  rationale   Json
  model       String?
  inputHash   String    @map("input_hash")
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([workspaceId, agentKind, subjectId, inputHash])
  @@index([workspaceId, agentKind])
  @@index([documentId])
  @@map("agent_verdicts")
}

/// Per-workspace touchless automation configuration (1:1 with Workspace).
model WorkspaceAutomationConfig {
  id                String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId       String    @unique @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  /// "suggest" | "auto" | "touchless" — the graduated Ramp-style autonomy this workspace runs
  /// at. Persisted so a saved level round-trips, and read by applyAutomationRules to decide
  /// whether the speculative fallbacks (vendor history, LLM) may run at all. Rules are
  /// workspace-authored policy and always apply.
  autonomyLevel     String    @default("auto") @map("autonomy_level")
  /// Legacy boolean kept because autopublish.ts still reads it. Kept in sync with autonomyLevel
  /// by updateAutomationConfig — touchlessEnabled is true iff autonomyLevel is "touchless".
  touchlessEnabled  Boolean   @default(false) @map("touchless_enabled")
  minConfidence     Float     @default(0.85) @map("min_confidence")
  requirePolicyPass Boolean   @default(false) @map("require_policy_pass")
  policyText        String?   @map("policy_text")
  blockOnWarnChecks Boolean   @default(false) @map("block_on_warn_checks")
  /// A1.3: fraction (0–1) of touchless-eligible documents to route through a non-blocking QA
  /// sample review — the workspace-level control on the trust-but-verify safety net that
  /// keeps a step-down threshold from silently drifting into a bad regime. Default 0.05.
  qaSampleRate      Float     @default(0.05) @map("qa_sample_rate")
  /// A1.2: amount-band routing. JSON array of AmountBand rows
  /// ({min,max,minConfidence,requireVerifiedSupplier?}) — a small verified-supplier invoice
  /// can be released to touchless with a laxer floor than the workspace default. Empty array
  /// = no band routing (workspace floor applies to every document).
  amountBands       Json      @default("[]") @map("amount_bands")
  /// A1.6: per-template critical-field maps. `{templateCode: [fieldKey, ...]}` — only these
  /// fields' low confidence block touchless for that template. Empty object = every field
  /// gates (historic behaviour), so opting in is a deliberate one-workspace change.
  criticalFieldsByTemplate Json @default("{}") @map("critical_fields_by_template")
  /// #55: confidence-per-band gate 5/6 from #40. Shape: `[{ upTo: number|null, min: number }]`
  /// sorted by `upTo` ascending, last row has `upTo: null` (the open-ended top band). A bill
  /// whose extraction confidence falls below its band's `min` fires the soft gate. #40 fixed
  /// the seed at 0.85 / 0.92 / 1.00 across 0–500 / 500–5k / 5k+. Kept separate from
  /// `amountBands` above because they answer different questions: `amountBands` relaxes the
  /// autopublish floor, this holds bills that miss the floor in the exception queue.
  confidenceBands   Json      @default("[{\"upTo\":500,\"min\":0.85},{\"upTo\":5000,\"min\":0.92},{\"upTo\":null,\"min\":1.0}]") @map("confidence_bands")

  /// #54: supplier-trust gate 4/6 from #40. Shape: `{ amount: number, currency?: string }`. A
  /// bill from an unverified supplier whose total exceeds this threshold fires the soft gate.
  /// `currency` is optional; unset means "resolve against workspace.baseCurrency at gate-eval
  /// time" so a base-currency change picks up without a data backfill. #40 fixed the seed at
  /// local-500.
  supplierTrustThreshold Json @default("{\"amount\":500}") @map("supplier_trust_threshold")

  /// #53: 2/3-way match variance tolerance (soft gate 3/6 from #40). Shape:
  /// `{ percent: number, floor: { amount: number, currency?: string } }`. `percent` is a
  /// fraction (0.02 = 2%). `floor.amount` is the local-currency minimum tolerance so a tiny
  /// bill's 2% doesn't collapse to pennies; `floor.currency` is omitted by default and read
  /// off `workspace.baseCurrency` at gate-evaluation time so a workspace that changes its
  /// base currency picks the new one up. #40 fixed the seed at 2% / 500. Never zero at
  /// default — a workspace that wants strict matching sets an explicit tolerance object.
  matchTolerance    Json      @default("{\"percent\":0.02,\"floor\":{\"amount\":500}}") @map("match_tolerance")
  createdAt         DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace         Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("workspace_automation_configs")
}

/// Routes review tasks to the right reviewer based on document attributes.
/// Evaluated in priority order (highest first); the first matching rule wins.
model ReviewRoutingRule {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId    String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  name           String
  priority       Int       @default(0)
  isActive       Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  /// Match criteria stored as JSON: { templateCode?, vendorPattern?, minAmount?, maxAmount? }
  matcher        Json
  assigneeId     String    @map("assignee_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace      Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  assignee       User      @relation("RoutingAssignee", fields: [assigneeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([workspaceId, isActive])
  @@map("review_routing_rules")
}

model WorkspaceBudget {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId    String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  name           String
  category       String?
  vendor         String?
  templateCode   String?   @map("template_code")
  /// Decimal(18,2) since Phase 1 — see lib/money.ts. Budget comparisons and % calculations happen
  /// in cents to avoid the 0.1+0.2 float trap when a budget's threshold sits near a boundary.
  amount         Decimal   @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  periodType     String    @default("monthly") @map("period_type")
  warnAtPercent  Int       @default(80) @map("warn_at_percent")
  isActive       Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace      Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([workspaceId, isActive])
  @@map("workspace_budgets")
}

/// WP-AP2: one payment run is a batch of bill payments the user prepared for their bank. The
/// row is created when they generate the CSV; `status` transitions draft → sent → reconciled as
/// the file is uploaded to the bank and the resulting ledger transactions match back to these
/// items via the existing bank-match pipeline. DocuBite never itself moves money — this table
/// exists purely to track what was included in a downloaded payment file so an unpaid bill isn't
/// silently re-batched into a second run.
model PaymentRun {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId   String   @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  createdById   String?  @map("created_by_id") @db.Uuid
  format        String   @default("za_eft_csv")
  status        String   @default("draft")
  itemCount     Int      @default(0) @map("item_count")
  totalsJson    Json?    @map("totals_json")
  filename      String?
  sentAt        DateTime? @map("sent_at")
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace     Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdBy     User?     @relation("PaymentRunCreator", fields: [createdById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  items         PaymentRunItem[]

  @@index([workspaceId, status])
  @@index([workspaceId, createdAt])
  @@map("payment_runs")
}

/// One bill (a Document) included in one PaymentRun. `documentId` is nullable + SetNull because
/// a workspace deleting the underlying document should not orphan the whole run; the item stays
/// as an audit record ("we tried to pay for this then the source was deleted"). Unique on
/// (workspaceId, documentId, active) so the same bill isn't in two open runs at once.
model PaymentRunItem {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId   String   @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  runId         String   @map("run_id") @db.Uuid
  documentId    String?  @map("document_id") @db.Uuid
  supplier      String
  amount        Decimal  @db.Decimal(18, 2)
  currencyCode  String   @map("currency_code")
  reference     String
  active        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  workspace     Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  run           PaymentRun @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  document      Document?  @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([workspaceId, runId])
  @@index([workspaceId, documentId, active])
  @@map("payment_run_items")
}

model DocumentMatch {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId    String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  sourceId       String    @map("source_id") @db.Uuid
  targetId       String    @map("target_id") @db.Uuid
  matchType      String    @map("match_type")
  confidence     Float
  discrepancies  Json      @default("[]")
  status         String    @default("pending")
  resolvedAt     DateTime? @map("resolved_at")
  resolvedById   String?   @map("resolved_by_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  workspace      Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  source         Document  @relation("MatchSource", fields: [sourceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  target         Document  @relation("MatchTarget", fields: [targetId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  resolvedBy     User?     @relation("MatchResolver", fields: [resolvedById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([sourceId, targetId])
  @@index([workspaceId, matchType])
  @@index([workspaceId, status])
  @@map("document_matches")
}

/// Quality-roadmap A5 (supplier identity): one canonical supplier per workspace, keyed by the
/// normalized form of its name (lib/suppliers/normalize.ts). Documents keep storing the raw
/// extracted vendor text — this table is the resolution layer consumers (automation rules, bank
/// matching, dedup, stats) look names up through, never a rewrite of what the document said.
/// `bankDetails` is the remembered remittance identity (iban/account/sortCode…) the A2.2
/// bank-detail-change freeze will compare against; `iban` is denormalized out of it as the
/// cross-supplier dedup anchor (same IBAN ⇒ same real-world payee, whatever the name says).
model Supplier {
  id            String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId   String    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  canonicalName String    @map("canonical_name")
  normalizedKey String    @map("normalized_key")
  bankDetails   Json?     @map("bank_details")
  domain        String?
  vatNumber     String?   @map("vat_number")
  iban          String?
  /// Rolling counters the per-supplier automation thresholds (A1.1) and anomaly checks (A2.7)
  /// will read; maintained by models/suppliers.ts's touchSupplier, not derived on read.
  documentCount Int       @default(0) @map("document_count")
  /// A1.1: rolling per-supplier automation stats — count of consecutive touchless documents
  /// approved without a reviewer correction. Reset to 0 by ANY correction on a document keyed
  /// to this supplier; drives the per-supplier threshold step-down (0.98 for a new supplier,
  /// down to max(minConfidence, 0.90) once at least 10 have been correct).
  consecutiveClean Int    @default(0) @map("consecutive_clean")
  /// Total touchless-eligible documents seen — powers A1.4 cold-start (always review the first
  /// N whatever their confidence).
  touchlessSeen Int       @default(0) @map("touchless_seen")
  lastSeenAt    DateTime? @map("last_seen_at")
  /// WP-AP2: net payment terms in days. When set, models/bills.ts's due-date inference uses
  /// `document.date + paymentTermsDays` when the extracted invoice has no explicit due_date. Null
  /// = no default (aging falls back to the extracted date or blank). Common values: 0 (due on
  /// receipt), 7, 14, 30, 60.
  paymentTermsDays Int?   @map("payment_terms_days")
  /// #54: supplier-trust gate 4/6 from #40. `verifiedAt` is set the first time a workspace admin
  /// confirms this supplier (the exception chip's inline-verify affordance, or a bulk-verify from
  /// the settings surface). Once set, the trust gate stops firing on this supplier's bills;
  /// clearing it (never done automatically today) puts them back into the exception queue for the
  /// threshold. `verifiedById` records the admin who did it. Both null on newcomers, which is
  /// what makes the gate fire in the first place.
  verifiedAt    DateTime? @map("verified_at")
  verifiedById  String?   @map("verified_by_id") @db.Uuid
